objective: Let the owner start a clean Vision scene-QA run for the currently configured provider/model from the desktop Dashboard without restarting Hina, while keeping all ratings bounded, memory-only and incapable of approving promotion.
non_goals: Do not reset another provider/model profile or clear every profile at once.
Do not persist, export or expose observation IDs, pixels, summaries, prompts, labels, chat text, API keys or per-observation ratings.
Do not reset automatically when the provider changes, a capture fails or a score is low.
Do not call a model, Cloud provider or capture API.
Do not change capture consent, fresh-context TTL, inference, text brain, STT, TTS, archive behavior, confidence thresholds or VRAM budgets.
contracts: Reset is available only through the trusted operator window and the runtime route requires the fixed owner.desktop source plus ownerConfirmed=true.
Reset removes only in-memory scene-QA samples whose provider and model exactly match the active Vision profile; samples for other profiles remain untouched.
The response exposes only the number removed and the same aggregate quality status; no observation-level record is returned.
The Dashboard asks for explicit confirmation, clears the renderer's last rating/capture result after success and requires a new capture before another rating.
Reset never changes the Vision provider, model, confidence threshold, capture archive, feature flag or promotionApproved=false invariant.
No new model call, persistence, image retention or local VRAM usage is introduced.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library, existing Electron/Vue/TypeScript stack and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger tests prove exact-profile deletion, cross-profile isolation, empty-reset determinism and removal of both rated and unrated samples.
Service and route tests prove operator-only confirmation, strict fields and aggregate-only reset response.
Desktop typed IPC exposes a no-argument reset operation; renderer cannot choose source, owner confirmation or target profile.
Dashboard explains the destructive in-memory-only effect, confirms before reset and disables reset when the active profile has no samples.
Module-brief validation, perception tests, core route tests, desktop typecheck/build/tests, repository fast tests and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S26-owner-vision-qa-session-reset-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/perception/tests -p "test_*.py"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s apps/core-runtime/tests -p "test_perception_routes.py"
